correctness.rationale: Graph is constructed on all 24 permutations of 4 letters by the three adjacent swaps; 36 undirected edges. Independent C++ enumerated every 6-,7-,8-vertex subset of 24 and reproduced 0,0,1767 dominating subsets. For every of 376,992 five-edge sets, direct deletion and checks against the entire 1767 original minimum-dominating sets gives exactly 276 winners, which is exhaustive and equivalent to gamma(T-F)>8 because edge deletions cannot lower domination number. Independent Python reconstructed each winning edge mask and full vertex-stars, yielding 240 sets isolating one vertex, 36 isolating two, none zero/>2; 13 per vertex. Independently generated 48 full automorphisms via symbol relabeling and permutation-position reversal, partitioning all 276 winners into eight exact orbits with source representatives. Finite exhaustive proof appropriate because T is fixed; no extrapolation. The previously established b=5 is not inferred solely from checking five-edge subsets.
residual_risks: Exhaustive enumeration validity depends on complete canonical S4 graph and all combinatorial subsets; both independently reconstructed.
